title: Kid Island's band, Mexico job and Fate Marable
summary: Vincent played about two years with Kid Island, went to Mexico, and describes Fate Marable's boat band breaking up and Jimmy Dave taking the job.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
